description: This file contains implementation of functions for configuring and retrieving user-defined field selectors in the RTL8367C switch hardware, specifically within the High-Speed Bus (HSB) interface. It provides functions to set and get selector configurations such as format and offset, along with relevant safety checks.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 format,rtk_uint32 offset)
methods.description: Configures a user-defined field selector in the RTL8367C device, allowing setting of format and offset based on provided parameters. Checks for parameter ranges and writes configuration to hardware registers.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 * pFormat,rtk_uint32 * pOffset)
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration of a specific user-defined field selector, outputting format and offset values after reading from hardware registers.

ctags.name: rtl8367c_getAsicFieldSelector
ctags.pattern: /^ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index, rtk_uint32* pFormat, rtk_uint32* pOffset)$/

ctags.name: rtl8367c_setAsicFieldSelector
ctags.pattern: /^ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index, rtk_uint32 format, rtk_uint32 offset)$/
